question.problem:
Consider the function $L:{R}^{2\times 3}\to R$ defined by $L(A)=(2Ax-b)^{T}(2Ax-b),$ where $$ x=[\begin{aligned}10 \\ 10 \\ -5\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}]. $$ What is ${∇}_{A}L$ at $A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}]?$
${∇}_{A}=\,\,$ {{field-1}} {{field-2}} $-240$
{{field-3}} {{field-4}} $-2140$
question.worked_solution:
The gradient of $L$ with respect to $A$ is a matrix of the same shape as $A$, with $(i,j)$th entry given by

$$
\frac{∂L}{∂{a}_{ij}},
$$

the partial derivative of $L$ with respect to the $(i,j)$th entry of $A.$

We can compute $\frac{∂L}{∂{a}_{ij}}$ by applying the chain rule.

Let $y=2Ax-b\in {R}^{2}.$ Then, $L(A)={y}^{T}y$ and

$$
\frac{∂L}{∂{a}_{ij}}={\sum }_{k=1}^{2}\frac{∂L}{∂{y}_{k}}\cdot \frac{∂{y}_{k}}{∂{a}_{ij}}
$$

Now, since 

$$
{∇}_{y}L={∇}_{y}({y}^{T}y)=2y,
$$

we have that

$$
\frac{∂L}{∂{y}_{k}}=2{y}_{k}.
$$

Writing out $y=2Ax-b$ in component-wise notation as 

$$
{y}_{i}=2{\sum }_{j=1}^{3}{a}_{ij}{x}_{j}-{b}_{i},
$$

we have 

- $\frac{∂{y}_{k}}{∂{a}_{ij}}=2{x}_{j}$ if $i=k$, and

- $\frac{∂{y}_{k}}{∂{a}_{ij}}=0$ if $i\ne k.$

This means that 

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂L}{∂{a}_{ij}} & ={\sum }_{k=1}^{2}\frac{∂L}{∂{y}_{k}}\cdot \frac{∂{y}_{k}}{∂{a}_{ij}} \\  & =\frac{∂L}{∂{y}_{i}}\cdot \frac{∂{y}_{i}}{∂{a}_{ij}} \\  & =2{y}_{i}\cdot \frac{∂{y}_{i}}{∂{a}_{ij}} \\  & =2{y}_{i}\cdot 2{x}_{j} \\  & =4{y}_{i}{x}_{j}\end{aligned}
$$

 The $(i,j)$th entry of ${∇}_{A}L$ is $4$ times the $i$th entry of $y$ multiplied by the $j$th entry of $x$, so

$$
{∇}_{A}L=4y\cdot {x}^{T}.
$$

 Finally, evaluating ${∇}_{A}L$ at $A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}],$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{∇}_{A}L & =4y\cdot {x}^{T} \\  & =4(2Ax-b)\cdot {x}^{T} \\  & =4(2[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 1 \\ 4 & 0 & -3\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}10 \\ 10 \\ -5\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}])\cdot [\begin{aligned}10 & 10 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =4([\begin{aligned}10 \\ 110\end{aligned}]-[\begin{aligned}-2 \\ 3\end{aligned}])\cdot [\begin{aligned}10 & 10 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}48 \\ 428\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}10 & 10 & -5\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}480 & 480 & -240 \\ 4280 & 4280 & -2140\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
